scope: Behavior, parts, events, hover-intent delays and state attributes of the web component in happy-dom (node:test), and the React renderer's server markup. Placement, rendered lengths and motion are covered by the browser geometry check and the React parity check; visual quality and screen-reader output are not certified.

checks.covers: preset and parts anatomy (the link keeps its role), hover intent (delay, close-delay, moving onto the card), keyboard focus, Escape, a press does not toggle, openchange reasons, no native form elements
resolvePopup('preview-card'): card-md padding and radius, collection gap, 80u cap
React SSR: the same data-* and recipe classes as the web component on host and parts, the trigger renders a link, the preset renders its parts

limitations: Placement, the top layer, :focus-visible and the reveal motion need a real browser; unit tests cover the attributes they key on.
React styling parity is checked in the browser: apps/studio/react-check.html ("fails": []).
No Backdrop part and no handles or payloads (one card for several links).

Geometry review, manual items (2026-11-02, studio Chromium at u = 3, 4, the theme unit 4.5 and 6, light and dark): growth (long card content wraps at 80u and the card grows; past the space below it flips above or scrolls), RTL (start / end alignment mirrors through the logical anchor rule), focus (the link keeps its own focus ring; Tab moves into the card's links, which keep theirs), screenshots of the Popups family and the size ladder checked light and dark.
